subject: pol-con
title: (R)POL.CON.-----PHY.U.P.
description: Diagram opening R(AS)CM(II)-27 — the section on creative-music as a closed-society continuum and the limited-work consequence for would-be younger musicians. The prose below identifies the structural target: 'The present situation in creative music must be viewed as a kind of closed-society continuum as a result of little exposure... many musicians try to function from the broadest possible base — having to do with travels outside of the country when possible.' The crossing diagrams how political-consciousness structurally meets physical-universe particulars at the closed-society scale: (R)POL-CON (the reality of political consciousness) crossed with PHY-U-P (physical-universe particulars — the material conditions the form encounters). POL-CON sits on the left with the subject-arrow, and its main line runs up-right to PHY-U-P. Two lines leave the main line: one rises to INFO-F (information focus), with DOC (documentation) branching from it at the upper-left; and one runs down-right to INDIV-DY-RT (individual dynamic reality), with three lines branching from it: PART (participation) and AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) below, and PROJ-DYM (projectional dynamics) to the right, with RE-ST (restructuralism) branching in turn from PROJ-DYM.
